description: This file defines a custom Swing label component `URLLabel` that displays a hyperlink-like text which, when clicked, opens the URL in the user's default browser. The class handles creating URI objects, setting up mouse interactions for visual cues and click actions, and managing platform support for opening URLs.

classes.name: URLLabel
classes.description: A Swing JLabel that displays a clickable hyperlink, opening the URL in the default browser when clicked, with visual effects on mouse hover.

methods.name: URLLabel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the label with text and a URI.

methods.name: URLLabel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the label with text and a string URI.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Converts a string to a URI object, throwing a runtime exception if the syntax is invalid.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the label, sets its text, tooltip, cursor, and mouse listeners for interaction.

methods.name: addUrlAction
methods.description: Adds a mouse click listener to open the specified URI when clicked.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Overrides JLabel's setText to include HTML styling with optional underline.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Attempts to open the provided URI in the default desktop browser, with error handling.
